page.notes: The Hebrew lines are set in the text column with no margin notes. Line 2 of the Hebrew contains a printed box-like glyph that I could not read; it is marked as illegible. The Hebrew and the Greek readings ("κατὰ λέξιν" in italic and roman) are my best reading of a small, slightly blurred scan. The Greek in the second occurrence and the first Hebrew line are uncertain. The page number and running head are reproduced as printed. The word "dices" is the catchword, so the text ends on "co-".
